failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS yr,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS mon,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT m18.mon AS month,
       m18.cnt AS orders_2018,
       m17.cnt AS orders_2017,
       m18.cnt - m17.cnt AS growth
FROM monthly m18
JOIN monthly m17 ON m18.mon = m17.mon AND m17.yr = 2017
WHERE m18.yr = 2018
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 12;
